```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(flextable)
library(readr)
library(readxl)

raw <- read_xlsx("../data/2026_ast_data_amik.xlsx")

head(raw)

```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
colnames(raw) <- trimws(colnames(raw))
cat("✔ File loaded:", nrow(raw), "rows x", ncol(raw), "columns\n")
cat("  Columns:", paste(colnames(raw), collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
id_col  <- "Isolate_ID"
org_col <- "Bacteria"
ab_cols <- setdiff(colnames(raw), c(id_col, org_col))

ast_long <- raw %>%
  rename(Isolate_ID = all_of(id_col),
         Organism   = all_of(org_col)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = all_of(ab_cols),
    names_to  = "Antibiotic",
    values_to = "Result"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Result)) %>%
  mutate(
    Result     = toupper(trimws(Result)),
    Organism   = trimws(Organism),
    Antibiotic = trimws(Antibiotic)
  ) %>%
  mutate(Organism = ifelse(Organism == "K,E,C", "Klebsiella", Organism)) %>%
  filter(Result %in% c("S", "I", "R")) %>%
  mutate(Result = factor(Result, levels = c("S","I","R"), ordered = TRUE))

cat("✔ Data reshaped:", nrow(ast_long), "observations (blanks excluded)\n")
cat("  Organisms  :", paste(sort(unique(ast_long$Organism)), collapse = " | "), "\n")
cat("  Antibiotics:", paste(sort(unique(ast_long$Antibiotic)), collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
```

# Table 1 — Resistance Summary

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
summary_table <- ast_long %>%
  group_by(Organism, Antibiotic) %>%
  summarise(
    n           = n(),
    S_n         = sum(Result == "S"),
    I_n         = sum(Result == "I"),
    R_n         = sum(Result == "R"),
    S_pct       = round(S_n / n * 100, 1),
    I_pct       = round(I_n / n * 100, 1),
    R_pct       = round(R_n / n * 100, 1),
    NonSusc_pct = round((I_n + R_n) / n * 100, 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Organism, Antibiotic) %>%
  mutate(
    S_cell  = paste0(S_n,  " (", S_pct,       "%)"),
    I_cell  = paste0(I_n,  " (", I_pct,       "%)"),
    R_cell  = paste0(R_n,  " (", R_pct,       "%)"),
    NS_cell = paste0(NonSusc_pct, "%")
  )

# Display table (columns shown)
display_t1 <- summary_table %>%
  select(Organism, Antibiotic, n, S_cell, I_cell, R_cell, NS_cell, NonSusc_pct)

# ── flextable ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ft1 <- display_t1 %>%
  select(-NonSusc_pct) %>%
  flextable() %>%
  set_header_labels(
    Organism   = "Organism",
    Antibiotic = "Antibiotic",
    n          = "n",
    S_cell     = "Sensitive (%)",
    I_cell     = "Intermediate (%)",
    R_cell     = "Resistant (%)",
    NS_cell    = "Non-Susceptible (%)"
  ) %>%
  add_header_lines("Table 1. Antimicrobial Susceptibility Profile by Organism") %>%
  add_footer_lines("Non-Susceptible % = Intermediate + Resistant combined") %>%

  # Merge repeated Organism cells
  merge_v(j = "Organism") %>%
  valign(j = "Organism", valign = "top") %>%

  # Header styling
  bg(part = "header", bg = "#2c3e50") %>%
  color(part = "header", color = "white") %>%
  bold(part = "header") %>%
  fontsize(part = "header", size = 11) %>%

  # Title row styling
  bg(i = 1, part = "header", bg = "#1a252f") %>%
  fontsize(i = 1, part = "header", size = 13) %>%

  # Body styling
  fontsize(part = "body", size = 10) %>%
  bg(part = "body", bg = "white") %>%

  # Alternating row stripes
  bg(i = seq(2, nrow(display_t1), 2), bg = "#f8f9fa", part = "body") %>%

  # Red: NonSusc = 100%
  color(
    i   = which(display_t1$NonSusc_pct == 100),
    j   = "NS_cell",
    color = "red"
  ) %>%
  bold(
    i   = which(display_t1$NonSusc_pct == 100),
    j   = "NS_cell"
  ) %>%

  # Orange: NonSusc 50–99%
  color(
    i   = which(display_t1$NonSusc_pct >= 50 & display_t1$NonSusc_pct < 100),
    j   = "NS_cell",
    color = "darkorange"
  ) %>%
  bold(
    i   = which(display_t1$NonSusc_pct >= 50 & display_t1$NonSusc_pct < 100),
    j   = "NS_cell"
  ) %>%

  # Alignment
  align(j = c("n","S_cell","I_cell","R_cell","NS_cell"),
        align = "center", part = "all") %>%
  align(j = c("Organism","Antibiotic"), align = "left", part = "all") %>%

  # Borders
  border_outer(part = "all",
               border = officer::fp_border(color = "#2c3e50", width = 2)) %>%
  border_inner_h(part = "body",
                 border = officer::fp_border(color = "#dee2e6", width = 0.5)) %>%

  # Column widths
  width(j = "Organism",   width = 1.3) %>%
  width(j = "Antibiotic", width = 1.4) %>%
  width(j = "n",          width = 0.4) %>%
  width(j = "S_cell",  width = 1.2) %>%
  width(j = "I_cell",  width = 1.5) %>%   # wider — "Intermediate (%)" is long
  width(j = "R_cell",  width = 1.2) %>%
  width(j = "NS_cell", width = 1.8) %>%   # wider — "Non-Susceptible (%)" is long %>%

  # Font
  font(fontname = "Arial", part = "all") %>%
  padding(padding = 5, part = "body") %>%
  fix_border_issues()

ft1

# ── Save high-res PNG ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
save_as_image(ft1, path = "Table1_Resistance_Summary.png", res = 400)
cat("✔ Saved: Table1_Resistance_Summary.png\n")
```

# Table 2 — MDR Assessment

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
mdr_table <- ast_long %>%
  group_by(Organism, Isolate_ID) %>%
  summarise(R_count = sum(Result == "R"), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Organism) %>%
  summarise(
    n_isolates = n(),
    MDR_n      = sum(R_count >= 3),
```

# Statistical Tests

## Fisher's Exact / Chi-Square (Inter-organism)

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

organisms <- sort(unique(ast_long$Organism))
pairs     <- combn(organisms, 2, simplify = FALSE)
all_test_results <- list()

for (pair in pairs) {
  org1 <- pair[1]; org2 <- pair[2]
  d1   <- ast_long %>% filter(Organism == org1)
  d2   <- ast_long %>% filter(Organism == org2)
  shared_abs <- intersect(unique(d1$Antibiotic), unique(d2$Antibiotic))
  if (length(shared_abs) == 0) next

  for (ab in shared_abs) {
    v1  <- factor(d1$Result[d1$Antibiotic == ab], levels = c("S","I","R"))
    v2  <- factor(d2$Result[d2$Antibiotic == ab], levels = c("S","I","R"))
    tab <- rbind(table(v1), table(v2))
    tab <- tab[, colSums(tab) > 0, drop = FALSE]
    if (ncol(tab) < 2) next

    expected   <- outer(rowSums(tab), colSums(tab)) / sum(tab)
    use_fisher <- any(expected < 5)

    if (use_fisher) {
      res       <- fisher.test(tab, simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = 10000)
      test_name <- "Fisher's Exact"
      stat_str  <- "—"
      p_val     <- res$p.value
    } else {
      res       <- chisq.test(tab)
      test_name <- "Chi-Square"
      stat_str  <- paste0("X2=", round(res$statistic, 2))
      p_val     <- res$p.value
    }

    sig   <- ifelse(p_val < 0.001, "***",
             ifelse(p_val < 0.01,  "**",
             ifelse(p_val < 0.05,  "*", "ns")))
    p_str <- ifelse(p_val < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_val, 3)))

    all_test_results[[paste(org1, org2, ab, sep = "|")]] <-
      data.frame(
        Organism_1 = org1, Organism_2 = org2, Antibiotic = ab,
        Test       = test_name, Statistic  = stat_str,
        p_value    = p_str,    Sig        = sig,
        p_raw      = p_val,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
  }
}

test_df <- do.call(rbind, all_test_results) %>%
  arrange(Organism_1, Antibiotic)

ft3 <- test_df %>%
  select(Organism_1, Organism_2, Antibiotic, Test, Statistic, p_value, Sig) %>%
  flextable() %>%

  # ── Column headers — capital italic P in P-value ────────────────────
  set_header_labels(
    Organism_1 = "Organism 1",
    Organism_2 = "Organism 2",
    Antibiotic = "Antibiotic",
    Test       = "Test Used",
    Statistic  = "Statistic",
    p_value    = "P-value",          # capital P
    Sig        = "Significance"
  ) %>%

  add_header_lines("Table 3. Inter-Organism Statistical Comparison") %>%

  # ── Footer — italic capital P ─────────────────────────────────────
  add_footer_lines(
    as_paragraph(
      as_chunk("Fisher's Exact: expected count < 5  |  Chi-Square: expected count \u2265 5  |  *** "),
      as_i("P"), as_chunk("<0.001  |  ** "),
      as_i("P"), as_chunk("<0.01  |  * "),
      as_i("P"), as_chunk("<0.05  |  ns = not significant")
    )
  ) %>%

  # ── Header styling ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  bg(part = "header", bg = "#2c3e50") %>%
  color(part = "header", color = "white") %>%
  bold(part = "header") %>%
  fontsize(part = "header", size = 11) %>%
  bg(i = 1, part = "header", bg = "#1a252f") %>%
  fontsize(i = 1, part = "header", size = 13) %>%

  # Italic capital P in column header row (row 2 = column label row)
  italic(i = 2, j = "p_value", part = "header") %>%

  # ── Body styling ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  fontsize(part = "body", size = 10) %>%
  bg(part = "body", bg = "white") %>%
  bg(i = seq(2, nrow(test_df), 2), bg = "#f8f9fa", part = "body") %>%

  # Red: ***

  # Orange: ** or *

        align = "left", part = "all") %>%
```

## Kruskal-Wallis Test (Within-organism)

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

ast_long <- ast_long %>%
  mutate(Score = as.integer(Result) - 1)  # S=0, I=1, R=2

kw_results <- list()

for (org in sort(unique(ast_long$Organism))) {
  sub     <- ast_long %>% filter(Organism == org)
  ab_list <- unique(sub$Antibiotic)
  groups  <- lapply(ab_list, function(ab) sub$Score[sub$Antibiotic == ab])
  vary    <- sapply(groups, function(g) length(unique(g)) > 1)
  groups  <- groups[vary]
  labels  <- ab_list[vary]
  if (length(groups) < 2) next

  res   <- kruskal.test(groups)
  sig   <- ifelse(res$p.value < 0.001, "***",
           ifelse(res$p.value < 0.01,  "**",
           ifelse(res$p.value < 0.05,  "*", "ns")))
  p_str <- ifelse(res$p.value < 0.001, "<0.001",
                  formatC(res$p.value, format = "f", digits = 4))

  kw_results[[org]] <- data.frame(
    Organism           = org,
    H_statistic        = round(res$statistic, 2),
    df                 = res$parameter,
    p_value            = p_str,
    Significance       = sig,
    Antibiotics_Tested = paste(labels, collapse = ", "),
    stringsAsFactors   = FALSE
  )
}

kw_df <- do.call(rbind, kw_results)

ft4 <- kw_df %>%
  flextable() %>%

  # ── Column headers — capital italic P in P-value ────────────────────
  set_header_labels(
    Organism           = "Organism",
    H_statistic        = "H Statistic",
    df                 = "df",
    p_value            = "P-value",          # capital P
    Significance       = "Significance",
    Antibiotics_Tested = "Antibiotics Tested"
  ) %>%

  add_header_lines("Table 4. Kruskal-Wallis Test (Within-Organism, Across Antibiotics)") %>%

  # ── Footer — italic capital P ────────────────────────────────────────
  add_footer_lines(
    as_paragraph(
      as_chunk("Ordinal scores: S=0, I=1, R=2  |  *** "),
      as_i("P"), as_chunk("<0.001  |  ** "),
      as_i("P"), as_chunk("<0.01  |  * "),
      as_i("P"), as_chunk("<0.05  |  ns = not significant")
    )
  ) %>%

  # ── Header styling ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  bg(part = "header", bg = "#2c3e50") %>%
  color(part = "header", color = "white") %>%
  bold(part = "header") %>%
  fontsize(part = "header", size = 11) %>%
  bg(i = 1, part = "header", bg = "#1a252f") %>%
  fontsize(i = 1, part = "header", size = 13) %>%

  # Italic capital P in column header row (row 2 = actual column labels)
  italic(i = 2, j = "p_value", part = "header") %>%

  # ── Body styling ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  fontsize(part = "body", size = 10) %>%
  bg(part = "body", bg = "white") %>%
  bg(i = seq(2, nrow(kw_df), 2), bg = "#f8f9fa", part = "body") %>%

  # Red: ***
  color(i = which(kw_df$Significance == "***"),
        j = "Significance", color = "red") %>%
  bold(i  = which(kw_df$Significance == "***"),
       j  = "Significance") %>%

  # Orange: ** or *
  color(i = which(kw_df$Significance %in% c("**", "*")),
        j = "Significance", color = "darkorange") %>%
  bold(i  = which(kw_df$Significance %in% c("**", "*")),
       j  = "Significance") %>%

  # Italic P in p_value body column
  italic(j = "p_value", part = "body") %>%

  # ── Alignment ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  align(j     = c("H_statistic", "df", "p_value", "Significance"),
        align = "center", part = "all") %>%
  align(j     = c("Organism", "Antibiotics_Tested"),
        align = "left", part = "all") %>%

  # ── Borders ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  border_outer(part   = "all",
               border = officer::fp_border(color = "#2c3e50", width = 2)) %>%
  border_inner_h(part   = "body",
                 border = officer::fp_border(color = "#dee2e6", width = 0.5)) %>%

  # ── Column widths ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  width(j = "Organism",           width = 1.3) %>%
  width(j = "H_statistic",        width = 1.0) %>%
  width(j = "df",                 width = 0.5) %>%
  width(j = "p_value",            width = 0.8) %>%
  width(j = "Significance",       width = 1.0) %>%
  width(j = "Antibiotics_Tested", width = 3.0) %>%

  font(fontname = "Arial", part = "all") %>%
  padding(padding = 6, part = "body") %>%
  fix_border_issues()
```

# Figure 1 — Stacked Bar Chart with Significance Stars

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# ── Plot data: Sensitive % only, drop zeros ───────────────────────────
plot_data_s <- summary_table %>%
  select(Organism, Antibiotic, S_pct) %>%
  filter(S_pct > 0) %>%
  left_join(
    kw_df %>% select(Organism, p_value, Significance),
    by = "Organism"
  )

# ── KW expression data: stars on top of italic P ─────────────────────
# Renders as:      ***
#            KW:    P  = <0.001
kw_expr_data <- plot_data_s %>%
  distinct(Organism, p_value, Significance) %>%
  mutate(
    expr_label = paste0(
  "bold('KW: ')~italic(P)~bold('=", p_value, "')^bold('", Significance, "')")
    )

# ── Function: build one plot for one organism ─────────────────────────
make_organism_plot <- function(org_name) {

  d      <- plot_data_s  %>% filter(Organism == org_name)
  kw_row <- kw_expr_data %>% filter(Organism == org_name)

  ggplot(d, aes(x = Antibiotic, y = S_pct)) +

    # Bars
    geom_bar(
      stat      = "identity",
      fill      = "#0077BB",
      color     = "white",
      linewidth = 0.3,
      width     = 0.65
    ) +

    # Percentage label on top of each bar
    geom_text(
      aes(label = paste0(S_pct, "%")),
      vjust    = -0.6,
      size     = 4.0,
      fontface = "bold",
      color    = "#1d3557"
    ) +

    # KW label — top right, above 100% line, stars on top of P
    geom_text(
      data        = kw_row,
      aes(x = Inf, y = 113, label = expr_label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      hjust       = 1.04,
      vjust       = 0.5,
      size        = 3.8,
      color       = "#cc3311",
      parse       = TRUE
    ) +

    # 100% reference line
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 100,
      linewidth  = 0.35,
      linetype   = "dashed",
      color      = "#aaaaaa"
    ) +

    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 120),
      breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100),
      labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
    ) +

    scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(add = 0.6)) +

    labs(
      title   = org_name,
      x       = "Antibiotic",
      y       = "Sensitive Isolates (%)",
      caption = bquote(atop(
        bold("Kruskal-Wallis test (ordinal scores: S=0, I=1, R=2)"),
        "***" ~ italic(P) < 0.001 ~ "|  **" ~ italic(P) < 0.01 ~ "|  *" ~ italic(P) < 0.05 ~ "|  ns = not significant"
      ))
    ) +

    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      plot.background    = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.background   = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.border       = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "#cccccc",
                                        linewidth = 0.5),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#eeeeee", linewidth = 0.5),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),

      axis.text.x   = element_text(angle = 38, hjust = 1,
                                    size  = 11, color = "#111111",
                                    face  = "bold"),
      axis.title.x  = element_text(size  = 12, color = "#111111",
                                    face  = "bold",
                                    margin = margin(t = 10)),
      axis.text.y   = element_text(size  = 11, color = "#111111",
                                    face  = "bold"),
      axis.title.y  = element_text(size  = 12, color = "#111111",
                                    face  = "bold",
                                    margin = margin(r = 10)),

      axis.ticks        = element_line(color = "#333333", linewidth = 0.4),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(0.2, "cm"),

      plot.title   = element_text(face  = "bold", size = 15,
                                   color = "#1d3557", hjust = 0.5,
                                   margin = margin(b = 10)),
      plot.caption = element_text(size  = 8, color = "#888888",
                                   hjust = 0, margin = margin(t = 10)),
      plot.margin  = margin(20, 30, 16, 20)
    )
}

# ── Loop: save one PNG per organism ───────────────────────────────────
organisms_list <- sort(unique(plot_data_s$Organism))

for (org in organisms_list) {

  p_org      <- make_organism_plot(org)
  clean_name <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", org)
  filename   <- paste0("Figure_Sensitive_", clean_name, ".png")

  ggsave(
    filename = filename,
    plot     = p_org,
    width    = 7,
    height   = 6,
    dpi      = 400,
    bg       = "white"
  )
  cat("✔ Saved:", filename, "\n")
}

cat("\n✔ All", length(organisms_list), "figures saved as individual PNGs\n")
```
